crossRefs.note: Praise Yahweh, all you nations! Extol him, all you peoples!

translations.web: Again, “Praise the Lord, all you Gentiles! Let all the peoples praise him.”
translations.bsb: And again: “Praise the Lord, all you Gentiles, and extol Him, all you peoples.”
translations.kjv: And again, Praise the Lord, all ye Gentiles; and laud him, all ye people.
translations.asv: And again, Praise the Lord, all ye Gentiles; And let all the peoples praise him.
